label: Diagram 3.1
caption: Diagram 3.1 | Maximum length of ramp at a given gradient | External steps forming part of an additional route
description: This is a line chart, titled at the bottom 'Diagram 3.1 Maximum length of ramp at a given gradient'. The left vertical axis is labelled 'Gradient of ramp', running from 1:20 at the top to 1:10 at the bottom, with a vertical arrow marked 'shallower' at the top and 'steeper' at the bottom. The bottom horizontal axis is labelled 'Maximum length of ramp flight (m)', marked 0 to 10; the top right is labelled 'Rise (mm)' with the figure 500. A boundary line runs horizontally at the 1:15 level from the left axis to the 5 m mark, then rises diagonally to the top right corner at 10 m / 500 mm. Plotted points along the line carry the figures 67, 133, 200, 268, 333, 375, 412, 444, 474 and 500, each with a vertical line to the base axis. The line divides the chart into a grey-shaded region to the right of the line and a white region to its left and below; a legend at the bottom right keys the grey square to 'does not comply' and the white square to 'satisfactory'. A note at the top right reads 'Notes: 1. Gradient x length of flight = rise e.g. 1/20 x 10 = 500mm'.
